technique_name: Analyze why a certain industry is successful
description: The game industry has experienced tremendous growth over the years due to a number of factors. One of the most prominent factors is the rise of digital distribution platforms, such as Steam and the App Store, which make it easier for developers to get their games to market. This has made the game industry more accessible for new developers, which has led to a larger variety of games and genres being available.
